args: SELECT f.path AS path, s.name, s.kind, s.line, s.end_line FROM symbols s JOIN files f ON f.id = s.file_id WHERE f.path IN ('network/src/main/kotlin/sample/network/HostSelector.kt','core/src/main/kotlin/sample/core/RetryPolicy.kt','network/src/main/kotlin/sample/network/HostStore.kt') ORDER BY f.path, s.line
